title: Flexible nonparametric inference for causal effects under the front-door model

split.decision: Materialized observed-only n=500 binary-mediator datasets; val and hidden-test each have 1000 independent replicates; latent U and generation seeds excluded.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical source MSE 0.006044; coverage 0.912. New protocol reference not rerun.

allowed_changes: Nuisance models, surrogate losses, density/propensity estimation, cross-fitting, targeting or other valid ATE estimators and numerical methods may change.
TMLE versus one-step/other valid front-door procedures, truncation and computational settings are methods for this fixed estimand.
When retaining the supplied estfd pipeline, changing only truncate_lower=0.001, truncate_upper=0.999, n.iter=15000 or cvg.criteria=0.001 does not count as a method improvement.
Only setting the existing `crossfit` or `superlearner` options of `estfd`, or only reporting the `$Onestep` result it already returns, also does not count.
fixed_contract: Improve front-door ATE estimation under the fixed weak-overlap binary-mediator experiment while maintaining nominal 95% interval coverage.
The front-door causal identification problem and ATE, binary mediator, n=500 observed X/A/M/Y and weak-overlap generator remain fixed.
Mean squared ATE error, strict interval inclusion, coverage>=.887, supplied datasets and independent-case inference remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not switch to ordinary confounded regression association, direct effect or another mediation estimand; add latent confounders/true ATE as inputs; or change outcomes/splits.
No oracle constants, hidden data, extra labeled simulations or changed metric/coverage.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

research_contract.objective: Improve front-door ATE estimation under the fixed weak-overlap binary-mediator experiment while maintaining nominal 95% interval coverage.
fixed_research_objects: The front-door causal identification problem and ATE, binary mediator, n=500 observed X/A/M/Y and weak-overlap generator remain fixed.

evidence.finding: TMLE and one-step are estimation methods for a common nonparametric front-door causal effect.
MSE and strict interval coverage evaluate the fixed ATE, independent of nuisance learner.
Binary mediator n=500 weak-overlap problem; TMLE is baseline method.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
